findings.F1: In rising markets the gain the idea found is in the Friday and Saturday bars, as tested: next-day excess over the coin's mean was +0.751 % on Fridays (235 cases, t 1.24 on 60 days, cases of a day together) and +1.340 % on Saturdays (225 cases, t 2.06 on 57 days), against −0.902 % on Thursdays and −0.075 % on Sundays.
findings.F2: The grading the idea claims did not show, and went partly the other way: on rising Fridays and Saturdays, the excess by quartile of the 60-day return was +1.442 % (t 3.31), +1.112 % (t 2.69), +0.538 % (t 1.05) and +1.070 % (t 1.70), from the mildest rise to the steepest, on 103 to 119 cases each; other weekdays stayed between −0.10 % and +0.25 % in every quartile.
findings.F3: In falling markets, betting against the previous day's move pays more the larger that move is against the coin's 30-day swing: +0.091 %, +0.211 %, +0.448 % and +0.931 % by quartile of the move's size, with t 0.33, 0.65, 1.58 and 1.93 on 242, 264, 260 and 177 days, cases of a day together.
findings.F4: This falling-market reversal does not appear elsewhere: in rising markets the same quartiles gave +0.302 %, −0.019 %, −0.382 % and −0.006 %, and in choppy markets they gave +0.261 %, −0.203 %, +0.426 % and +0.118 %, with no gradient.
findings.F5: Within the two largest quartiles of the falling-market reversal, the effect is the same after up days (+0.671 %, t 1.55, 172 days) and after down days (+0.682 %, t 1.61, 172 days), it is positive on all six coins (+0.262 % on XRP to +0.938 % on ZEC), and its size varies by year (2018 +0.558 %, 2019 +0.275 %, 2020 +2.975 %, 2021 −0.152 %).
findings.F6: Other angles showed nothing that stands out once a day's cases are taken together:

ideas.idea: In a falling market, after a day whose move is large against the coin's swing of the past 30 days, the coin moves back the other way over the next day, after a rise as after a fall, and the move back is larger the larger that day's move.
ideas.consequence: In a downtrend, a trader would fade the previous day's outsized move for one day, with a larger position the larger the move, and would not fade small moves or moves in other markets.
ideas.name: falling-market one-day overreaction reversal
